title: Personal Assistant (PA) to the Director
raw_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Personal Assistant (PA) to the Director
Full-Time | On-Site / Office-Based
Experience: 2+ Years    Department: Executive Office
Job Summary
We are looking for a highly organized, discreet, and proactive Personal Assistant (PA) to provide administrative
and executive support to the Director. The successful candidate will manage schedules, coordinate meetings and
travel, handle correspondence, prepare documents, and help ensure that daily priorities and office activities run
smoothly. The role requires excellent communication, time management, attention to detail, and the ability to
handle confidential information professionally.
Key Responsibilities
•
Manage the Director’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and reminders; resolve scheduling conflicts and prioritize
requests.
•
Screen and coordinate phone calls, emails, visitors, and incoming correspondence.
•
Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, presentations, minutes, and follow-up action lists.
•
Arrange domestic and international travel, including transport, accommodation, itineraries, and expense
documentation.
•
Maintain organized digital and physical records, files, and confidential documents.
•
Coordinate with internal departments, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders on behalf of the Director.
•
Track pending tasks, deadlines, approvals, and commitments, and provide timely reminders.
•
Assist with expense reports, reimbursement claims, invoice follow-ups, and basic administrative records.
•
Support office operations and special projects as assigned by the Director.
•
Exercise discretion when handling sensitive business, employee, client, or personal information.
Must-Have Requirements
•
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Arts, or a related field; equivalent relevant
experience may be considered.
•
At least 2 years of experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Office Coordinator, or in a similar
administrative role.
•
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional local languages are an advantage.
•
Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, including email, calendars, documents, spreadsheets, and
presentations.
•
Excellent calendar management, meeting coordination, organization, and time-management skills.
•
Ability to prioritize multiple requests, work independently, and meet deadlines.
•
Professional conduct, reliability, attention to detail, and sound judgment.
•
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information responsibly.
Nice-to-Have Requirements
•
Previous experience supporting a Director, CEO, senior executive, or leadership team.
•
Experience coordinating travel, events, board meetings, or executive presentations.
•
Familiarity with expense management systems, document management tools, and video-conferencing platforms.
•
Strong follow-up and stakeholder coordination skills.

•
Ability to adapt quickly to changing schedules and urgent requests.
Core Skills
Administrative: Calendar management, travel planning, correspondence, meeting minutes, document
preparation, record keeping, expense tracking, and task coordination.
Professional: Communication, discretion, confidentiality, prioritization, problem-solving, adaptability, and
stakeholder management.
Selection Process
•
Resume screening.
•
Communication and email-writing exercise.
•
Calendar, scheduling, and prioritization task.
•
Interview with the Director or hiring team.
•
Reference and employment verification, where applicable.
Success Criteria
The successful candidate will keep the Director’s schedule organized, ensure meetings and travel are well
coordinated, follow up on important actions, communicate professionally with stakeholders, and protect
confidential information.
